mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in TRANSIT mobility indicates suppression of routine trips, which directly reduces retail-and-recreation footfall; as TRANSIT stays below -60, RETAIL_REC will continue to fall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -35.3 to -64.9 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days is greater than or equal to its mean over last 28 days while TRANSIT remains below -60.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES mobility crosses below -50, mandated workplace closures remove commuter-driven retail demand; this drag keeps RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over next 14 days after WORKPLACES crosses below -50.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays above 18 and PARKS drops below -35, residents are confined to home with limited outdoor release, cutting non-essential retail trips; RETAIL_REC will decline over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over next 14 days exceeds its last 14-day mean while RESIDENTIAL>18 and PARKS<-35.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a decline in GROCERY_PHARM below -10 signals reduced essential shopping frequency, which spills over into fewer retail visits; RETAIL_REC remains depressed over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM fell from +15.1 to -15.1 over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is higher than last 28-day mean despite GROCERY_PHARM<-10.

mechanism_narrative: As autumn progresses, PARKS mobility recovers from -42.1 to -35.7, indicating outdoor substitution; this pulls some recreation demand away from indoor retail, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rebounded from -42.1 to -35.7 in final week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 7-day mean is higher than last 7-day mean while PARKS continues to improve.

mechanism_narrative: Because RESIDENTIAL mobility has risen to 22.3, home confinement fatigue may trigger compensatory retail trips as restrictions are perceived to ease; RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 28-day mean is lower than last 28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL stays above 20.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT stabilizes above -65 and WORKPLACES stops falling, the worst mobility contraction is over; pent-up demand lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is lower than last 14-day mean after TRANSIT>-65 and WORKPLACES>-55.

mechanism_narrative: If PARKS mobility crosses above -30, it signals relaxation of outdoor exercise limits; this leads retail-and-recreation to recover with a two-week lag.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS=-35.7 at t-0w, above its -42.1 trough
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC next 14-day mean is lower than last 14-day mean after PARKS crosses above -30.
